test_title: PYST 16: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
Match the following items.

 
 

 **List I**
 **List II**
 
 

 i. Global System of Trade Preferences
 a.2021
 
 

 ii. India-Gulf Cooperation Council Free Trade Agreement
 b.1988
 
 

 iii. The India-Republic of Korea Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement
 c.2004
 
 

 iv. 7th Trade Policy Review
 d.2010
solution:
The correct answer is __**i (b), ii (c), iii (d), iv (a)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Global System of Trade Preferences (GSTP)** was established in 1988 to increase trade among developing countries.
 
• The **India-Gulf Cooperation Council Free Trade Agreement** negotiations began in 2004 to enhance economic cooperation between India and the GCC states.
 
• The **India-Republic of Korea Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)** was signed in 2010 to promote greater economic collaboration and trade between India and South Korea.
 
• The **7th Trade Policy Review** of India was conducted in 2021 by the World Trade Organization (WTO) to review India's trade policies and practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Global System of Trade Preferences (GSTP)**

 
 
• It was established in 1988 during the UN Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD).
 
• It aims to promote trade among developing countries through the exchange of tariff concessions.
 
 
 
• **India-Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) Free Trade Agreement**
 
 
• The GCC consists of Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE.
 
• FTA negotiations started in 2004 to facilitate trade and economic cooperation between India and GCC countries.
 
 
 
• **India-Republic of Korea Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)**
 
 
• CEPA was signed in 2010 to foster trade and economic relations between India and South Korea.
 
• The agreement covers trade in goods, services, investment, and intellectual property rights.
 
 
 
• **Trade Policy Review Mechanism (TPRM)**
 
 
• It was established in 1989 under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) and is now an integral part of the WTO.
 
• The 7th Trade Policy Review of India in 2021 aimed to evaluate and improve the transparency of India's trade policies.
